lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field set by the onlyGuardian before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field observed after rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_corrupted_after_rebase.meaning: the lockMode field is corrupted by rebaseOraclePack execution, i.e. its post-execution value differs from the guardian-set value

assumptions: rebaseOraclePack is the checked action whose execution is claimed to corrupt lockMode.
The lockMode value set by the onlyGuardian is the reference value that must be preserved.
limitations: Report does not state who may call rebaseOraclePack; caller authorization is not part of this claim.
Report does not specify the concrete post-rebase lockMode value, only that it is corrupted (differs from the preserved value).
The impact text 'corrupts the lockMode' is formalized as a post-execution value differing from the guardian-set value; code-level binding is deferred.
